structured.answer: After 6 years I can take it out with no tax. With a salary of about 12,000 I'd put in 18,000 ₪ of my own over 5 years, and I think I'd end up with something like 50–66 thousand. If I take it out early, the fund sends a huge chunk to tax (29,768 ₪, "47%"), so I just wait the 6 years.

stuck.where: Calculator, chart under 'מושכים את הכסף אחרי 5 שנים'
stuck.why: It opens on 5 years, the year with tax, but the 6-year rule is what I care about. The big bars have no shekel figures on them except '18,000 ₪', so I couldn't see what I'd actually get at 6 years.

'נכנסים קודם 50,719 ₪' and then '29,768 ₪ למס' and then '15,794 ₪ חוזרים'. I couldn't tell how much is left in my hands. Then a separate '66,601 ₪ עד 66,280 ₪' further down, and I'm not sure which number is my final amount.
I only know my take-home, 9,500, not the gross, so I left 12,000 where it was.
